author: sole authorized independent evaluator; source-blind
scope: bounded #520 synthetic launch retraction/denial/withdrawal/non-event source qualification only
authorship: 60 new hand-authored cases in 30 controlled semantic pairs; 30 positive and 30 negative. Fictional sources, not real primary documents. v1-v21 are seen development evidence, including unexecuted drafts.

qualification_rules.positive: Direct factual target launch anchor plus only fully specified non-launch property corrections or uniquely foreign event corrections. Both v17 requested_relation and v30 Relevant required.
qualification_rules.negative: Explicit target launch/existence/global denial, ownerless/ambiguous/mixed/conflicting adverse event, or actual owner-bearing context gap. Both v17 non-requested and v30 non-Relevant required.
qualification_rules.risk: raw/effective risk independent from relation; no raw-only joint negative; exact diagnostics retained without internal component inference.
qualification_rules.scoring: byte-identical inherited scorer; v29 diagnostic only; missing rows, malformed data, stderr, failed invocation prevent PASS.

no_label_leakage: Engine process receives only inputs.json, with id/policy/candidate/proposal/raw. Expected/rationale/polarity/axis stay in cases.json outside the process.

compile unchanged public probe into dedicated new tmp, no run

pre_freeze_corrections: If necessary, preserve original bytes/static result/exact diff/reason and expected polarity before complete freeze. None made during original AST review.
post_freeze: No changes to labels/inputs/criteria, no semantic retry, no rescoring; failures preserved.

isolation.writes: new v22 prefix and dedicated tmp probe only
